name: brokerdesk
description: BrokerDesk – multi-tenant real estate CRM SaaS

scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build -w @brokerdesk/api && npm run build -w @brokerdesk/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @brokerdesk/api && npm run lint -w @brokerdesk/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @brokerdesk/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w @brokerdesk/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @brokerdesk/api && npm run test:e2e -w @brokerdesk/api && npm run test -w @brokerdesk/web
